What changed: stores that started or stopped publishing a UCP profile

Between our crawls of 26 October 2026 and 2 November 2026, 4 retailers and stores started publishing a UCP profile, the profile AI shopping agents read, and 1 stopped. Of the stores that had a profile, 1 couldn't be checked this time, so it is not counted as leaving. In the crawl of 2 November 2026, 947 of the 2854 retailers and stores we track publish a UCP profile (same stores tracked both weeks: 775 of 2179, was 773).

How we count: each crawl is compared, store by store, with the previous one. Joined means a store we already tracked now has a UCP profile at /.well-known/ucp after the previous crawl found none or couldn't check it. Left means a store had a profile in the previous crawl and its website answered this time without one. Couldn't check means the website blocked our crawler or was unreachable, so we don't know, and we never count that as leaving. Stores added to our list are shown as newly tracked, not as joining. Details are in the methodology.

Same stores as last week: 775 of the 2179 retailers and stores we tracked in both crawls publish a UCP profile (last week: 773). Joined and left count only these. 675 stores are newly tracked this week and not counted as joining. See them →

Frequently asked questions

What counts as a store joining?

A store we already tracked joins when our crawl now finds a UCP profile at /.well-known/ucp and the previous crawl found none or couldn't check it. Stores newly added to our list are shown as newly tracked, not as joining.

What counts as a store leaving?

A store leaves when the previous crawl found a UCP profile and its website answered this time without one. If the website blocked our crawler or was unreachable, the store is listed under "couldn't check" and is not counted as leaving.

How often is this page updated?

After every crawl. The crawl runs on Mondays; the latest was on 2 November 2026 and the next is due on 9 November 2026. How we compare crawls.
